name: polygon-adventure
description: Polygon Adventure: a two-part game about polygons. Part 1 (Swiftee & the Polygons) is a narrated story lesson; Part 2 (Frozen Rush) is an ice runner where the same ideas mend the path. Both are plain static sites with no build step.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix part1-swiftee-lesson install && npm --prefix part2-frozen-rush install
scripts.test: npm run test:part1 && npm run check:part2
